comment: W02-15 release checklist of the OpenAI-compatible API (design/02 §7 W02-15, masterplan W02-15 'Flip erst bei grüner Checkliste', W06-20). Every item is green before gateway.enabled goes true in production. kind: config = a value read from the running stack; probe = smoke.py/measure.py subcommand with an exit code; measure = measure.py subcommand whose JSON result is recorded (threshold in 'pass'); manual = an operator step with its evidence. 'tool' names the subcommand that checks it (smoke.py/measure.py --list prints them). docs/operations.md 'Upgrading to 5.33.0: enabling the OpenAI-compatible API' lists every id.

items.pass: CTX_TRUSTED_PROXY holds the reverse proxy's address as ctxd sees it (docker exec ctx printenv CTX_TRUSTED_PROXY before the flip); right after the flip a request through the proxy is the door's 401, not 503 proxy_misconfigured, and a consumer whose allowed_cidrs holds only the proxy's address is refused (measure.py proxy --admin-key-env … --proxy-addr …: trusted_proxy_set + allowlist judges_client; before the flip it reports gateway_off, the door is behind the flag)
the running image carries the RC-D release (GET /health version) and the database is at its migration
before the flip an anonymous POST /v1/chat/completions is 404 not_found in the OpenAI envelope (no database statement: TestV1FlipProbe)
no foreign_load row of /api/status reports suspected load on a GPU target
spark-chat carries internal_reserved_slots 4 and spark-embed 1 (A03-W12 activation data), abort_settle_ms from the A03-W11 measurement

with the flag on: test consumer created, GET /v1/models 200, chat non-stream and stream, embeddings, rerank schema-valid with usage > 0 and no reasoning_content, 401 without a key, consumer deleted; with the flag off T25 is SKIP with its reason, never PASS
SGLang num_running_reqs falls back after a client abort (stream and non-stream); the decay time is recorded and becomes abort_settle_ms; no fall-back is a finding for 03
the prefill of a 200k-token prompt is measured against the commit grace and the proxy read timeout (no cut-off of a 50-s prefill)
memory peak of the ctx container under a flood of 64 streams from 8 consumers stays below gateway.inflight_budget above the idle base; peak_bytes is compared with the container limit by hand

every 429 of ctx under the flood carries x-should-retry and Retry-After in [1, ceil(30 x (1 + gateway.retry_after_jitter))] (45 at the default 0.5), at least one is seen; a reverse proxy's own 429 (no JSON body, no x-should-retry) counts as proxy_429 outside the verdict; the ctx 429 share is recorded
interactive latency under the external flood <= 2.0 x the 30-min baseline window
gateway.enabled=false answers 404 on the next request and ends running streams within 5 s
